metadata.title: Clicked like a confused potato and somehow got that 1 kill? Valorant just gave up logic!
metadata.description:
Me: zero aim, max panic
Enemy: uninstalling to rethink life
Valorant said ‘Here, have this kill, no questions asked’
Click if your aim’s a beautiful disaster too!

Tap if your aim’s a meme but kills still happen!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
